title: Use scoped workbook import/export
summary: Review a scoped import file before the upload can create or update resource rows.

evidence: server/src/utils/guideOracleKnowledge.js: reviewed original fact objects at b8345be4d2f7a097e81cb03eef64b473abd0cec9

sections.title: Review a resource workbook before its immediate import
paragraphs: The current Admin → Data Tools workspace is for Super Admin accounts. A workbook upload can create or update real records immediately. Complete the file and scope review before choosing Upload Workbook; this is not the Guide’s draft/review/Create workflow.
steps: Open Dashboard → Admin → Data Tools and find the matching Asset Workbook Tools card: Places, Standalone Offerings, Templates, Groups or Template Rollouts.
Select Excel template on that card and read its Guide, Data and Reference sheets. Choose the same resource type for the file and upload destination.

Prepare and review the Data rows using stable external keys. Names do not drive updates. Separate standalone Offerings from generated template rollouts; rollout rows use the template and host keys described in the workbook.

Check required values, relationships, the intended create/update scope and any schedule, visibility or access consequences. Keep a reviewed export of the current relevant data where needed for comparison.
Select Upload Workbook and choose the reviewed .xlsx file only when ready for its immediate import. CSV is a data-only fallback; it does not include the Excel Guide and Reference sheets.
Wait for the Import Report and inspect Total, Created, Updated, Skipped, Warnings and Errors. Use Copy or Download .txt to retain the report in an authorised operational location.

Check the intended resources after import. Resolve reported failures or warnings before deciding whether any corrected upload is needed; a partly successful report does not mean every row was applied.
notes: Places derive their service area from postcode on the server; imported service-area overrides are not a way to reroute them.
Group workbooks manage list-only profiles and public resource-member links. They do not create location pins or governance groups of people.
Choosing the wrong resource type or changing stable keys can change the import’s meaning. Review the template rules and current records before uploading again.
Do not share workbooks or row-error reports publicly. Keep private resource information, account details and credentials out of the Guide and public help.
The Guide cannot upload or import a workbook for you, and the upload has no preliminary chat confirmation stage.

sections.title: Export the selected resource type’s current data
paragraphs: Use the permitted workbook workspace and verify the type and scope before downloading. An export is an operational file to review, not a public map or a backup/restore guarantee.
steps: Sign in as an authorised Super Admin and open Dashboard → Admin → Data Tools → Asset Workbook Tools.
Choose the exact resource-type card. Standalone Offerings and Template Rollouts are separate exports.

Select Export current data on that card and wait for the Excel download. This exports the selected type’s current permitted data; the Data Tools card is not the Manage My Resources filtered-result export.
Open the downloaded workbook and check its Guide, Data and Reference sheets, row scope and stable keys before using it for comparison or an import.

Store or share the file only through authorised operational channels. If the download fails, review the reported export error before trying again; do not treat a missing or partial file as a completed export.
notes: For only an active managed-resource filter, use Export filtered workbook in Manage My Resources when offered, and verify its reported scope. Do not assume an Admin Data Tools export inherits a search elsewhere in the app.
Downloading does not itself create or update listings. Uploading a revised workbook is a separate immediate-write operation and requires its own review.
Review the file for internal keys and any sensitive operational details before sharing. The Guide does not inspect or export private records from this general procedure.

facts.title: Import an asset workbook
facts.message: Asset workbook imports are in Admin → Data Tools for Super Admin accounts. Choose the matching resource type; Standalone Offerings are separate from template-generated rollouts. Download the Excel template and review its Guide, Data and Reference sheets. Stable external keys drive updates; names do not. Upload Workbook starts the import immediately and may create or update rows, so check the file before uploading and review the Import Report afterward. CSV is a data-only fallback. This is separate from the Guide’s Programme/service draft-review-Create action; the Guide cannot import the file for you.
